quests.title: Tea Party Re-Invitation: Furina

dialogue.t: Ahhh! I'll never get tired of leisurely afternoon teas.

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: My, my... Joyful times truly do pass by in a flash.

quests.description: Go to the Opera Epiclese, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Furina…
